name: pecans-monorepo
description: Pecans Two Cans & String API wrapper and MCP server

scripts.generate: bun run generate:ts && bun run generate:py
scripts.generate:ts: bun run --filter pecans-spec generate && biome format --write sdks/typescript/src/generated
scripts.generate:py: bun run --filter pecans-spec generate:py && uvx ruff format sdks/python/src/pecans
scripts.build: bun run generate && bun run --filter pecans build
scripts.clean: bun run --filter pecans clean && bun run --filter pecans-spec clean
scripts.format: biome format --write . && uvx ruff format sdks/python/src/pecans
scripts.format:check: biome format . && uvx ruff format --check sdks/python/src/pecans
